model: LG + CAT, branch lengths rescaled under Gamma20; local support values (Shimodaira-Hasegawa-like, 1,000 resamples)
alignment: 283 human Class A receptors x 298 GPCRdb generic residue positions (the atlas position axis; '-' where a receptor lacks the position), leaves named by receptor id
regenerate: write the alignment from atlas/index.json (layers.aa, one row per receptor), run the command, replace the .nwk; the atlas builder falls back to neighbor joining when the file's leaves do not match the receptor list
